scope: Conditional force sensitivity only. No motion data or response scoring. Compare two different depth structures that reproduce the source image within the predeclared gross 5 percent diagnostic.
source_discretization: Bilinear planar interpolation with each component's source integral preserved. Vertical exponentials use exact cell-integrated weights, without renormalizing a truncated tail.
limitations: The two models have different recovered planar distributions as well as different heights; this is joint deprojection sensitivity, not a pure height perturbation.
A 5 percent source-image diagnostic does not imply observational posterior admission. Source covariance, absolute calibration, missing phases and external fields remain unresolved.
A constant stellar mass-to-light ratio is assumed for both vertical populations. Light fractions are therefore conditional mass fractions here.
Native source instrumental blurring remains; the true small-scale baryon distribution has not been recovered.
Numerical followups initially cover the thin case. The mixed case must not inherit a convergence certificate it has not been tested for.
